metric: referenced keys only; values = runtime truth (vm-evaluated locale modules); untranslated = value byte-identical to en-US; cjk = /[\u4e00-\u9fff\u3400-\u4dbf]/; sameAsSource = ALL keys, value byte-identical to source locale zh-CN AND that source value contains CJK (conservative: also counts legitimate zh-Hant/zh-JP homographs ⇒ an indicator, not an exact defect count); cjkInNonCjkLocaleAllKeys = ALL keys, values containing CJK in non-CJK locales (catches dynamically-resolved keys the referenced-key population cannot see)
